column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: one arm per dialect, each calling testutil.TestDB, so mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name: CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES=<pg> go test ./engine/ -run TestAWorkflowResultContractIsTheIntersection -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these two. All three arms must exist even where they skip, because the thing under test IS the disagreement between them: the contract documented in docs/reference/database-backends.md 7.4 is the INTERSECTION of three different column types, and a postgres-only run vouches for the loosest of the three -- it accepts every payload the other two reject. cleat#1025.
